releases.changelog:
1. Optimized the vibration effects in certain scenes for Switch console.

2. Added the ability to cancel back button mapping. When a button mapping is set for the back button, pressing the Setting button followed by the back button will cancel the current back button mapping, accompanied by a long vibration as a reminder.

3. Fixed an issue where having multiple back button mappings with button rapid fire functionality would affect other back buttons.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Optimized the startup connection speed.
2. Improved the output method when lightly pressing the trigger.
3. Enhanced vibration stability when the battery is low.
4. Improved wireless transmission stability.
5. Added a dead zone mode for the joysticks, with the default being no dead zone. You can set the joystick to have a dead zone mode by pressing the Set button and the Screenshot button, which will be accompanied by a short vibration as a reminder.
6. Fixed an issue where the back buttons couldn't map to the triggers in PC mode.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Optimized the vibration effects of Super Haptic vibration mode and HD rumble mode in Switch mode.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Added to turn the logo light into purple in APG datas sharing mode, and the controller will automatically power off after 10 minutes of inactivity.
2. Fixed occasional unresponsiveness of the D-pad left and right buttons in the D-pad 4-directions mode.
3. Fixed gyroscopic jumping issue in Switch mode.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Optimized the vibration effects of Super Haptic vibration mode and HD rumble mode in Switch mode.
2. Resolved the issue of the controller skipping two spaces in certain game menus during usage.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.Fixed the issue in XINPUT mode where the left motor vibration frequency would increase upon restarting.

2.Based on user feedback, adjustments are made to the back button mapping. Now, when setting up back button mapping, it no longer needs to follow the rapid-fire function of the front buttons. This allows for front buttons to have rapid-fire functionality while the back button mapping retains the long-press function. Players can freely choose between using long-press or rapid-fire functionality in games.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Add 3 kinds of joystick star ring lighting effects. Setting is still made with the "Set button + D-pad left button". Star ring lighting modes are: Default steady on, Joystick-activated flowing lighting, Vibration -activated lighting, Trigger -activated flowing lighting, Off.

2. Fixed an issue where certain controllers cannot be started after upgrade for the first time.

1.Refined the trigger mechanism to enable faster and more accurate triggering in digital trigger mode.

2.Fixed the problem where the controller would enter APG sharing mode when power on if the USB cable was not disconnected after flashing the firmware on XINPUT mode.

3. Fixed the problem where the controller would have USB cable disconnected on XINPUT wired mode when setting the joystick star-ring lighting mode.
1. Fixed the problem where the key combination for joystick calibration would not work after the replacement of A&B buttons.
1. Fixed the issue of no vibration in wired connection to PC with the controller on Switch mode.
1. Fine-tune PC motion sensing aim assist to improve its sensitivity in the left and right directions.
1. Added support for wireless wake-up on STEAM DECK OLED after STEAM DECK OLED enters sleep mode.

1. Optimized the vibration effects of Super Haptic vibration mode and HD Linear vibration mode for the controller in Switch mode.
2. Fixed an issue where the default Switch mode could not save the functional settings after upgrading the controller firmware without switching modes.
3. Fixed some system bugs.

1. Fixed an issue where the controller had slight vibrations even after disabling vibration in Super Haptic mode and HD Linear mode in Switch mode.
2. Increased the default vibration intensity in Super Haptic mode and HD Linear mode by 20% for the controller in Switch mode.
3. Fixed an issue where the controller occasionally automatically threw the hat in the game Super Mar** Odyssey in Switch mode.

1.Added a feature where, when the lighting settings are turned off, the logo light will still illuminate in purple as a reminder when pressing key combinations to set the controller into APG Recording File Share Mode.
2.Optimized the joystick's flowing light mode to address the occasional issue where the joystick returns to the center but the lights don't fully turn off.
3.Improved the speed of certain system operations.
1. Optimized the data processing method of the controller, resulting in faster wireless transmission speed.

1. Added the function where the logo light will still flash to indicate low controller battery in light-off mode.
2. Fixed the occasional issue of resetting the vibration mode when switching vibration strength.
3. Optimized the wireless transmission speed.
1. Optimized the vibration effects of HD mode and Super Haptic mode for the controller on Switch mode.

1. Added one more level option to set vibration intensity, changed from 2 levels(Weak/Strong) of vibration intensity setting options to 3 levels(Weak/Middle/Strong). 
    The default setting is at the 2nd level (Middle).
1. Fixed the problem where the vibration frequency would follow the Switch mode when switching to XINPUT mode, if the controller was not powered off or the settings were not cleared.
1.The power management strategy of the controller has been adjusted, increasing the usage time from full charge to low battery indicator flashing by 40%.
1. Fixed the occasional issue of incorrect lighting brightness when switching modes on controllers.
1. Fixed an issue where the previous button occasionally wouldn't release when rapidly switching between buttons.
1.Optimized a vibration-related issue in adapter mode on controller.
1.Fixed the issue where the button occasionally does not trigger when held down for a long time in PC adapter mode on controller.

1. Optimized the wireless connection, and increased the Bluetooth polling rate in Xinput mode to 170Hz.
2. Added the function of power off by pressing and holding the Home button for 4 seconds.
3. Controller reconnect time increased from 20 seconds to 70 seconds.
4. Added the function that the controller does not shut down when it is USB wired connection.
5. The automatic shutdown has been increased from 10 minutes to 15 minutes when the controller is inactive.
